title: layers
description: The architectural layers of the code the question touches (controller / service / repository / worker …), top to bottom, with the files in each and the rule that keeps a layer apart. Not rendered when `layers` is empty.

layers.description: Ordered from the top layer (the entry point) to the bottom one.

id.description: Part id, unique in the block; a route step can focus the row.

role.description: The layer's role: controller, service, repository, worker …

package.description: Folder or package the layer lives in, shown in mono under the role.

files.description: Files of the layer, each drawn as a chip. Give each one an anchor: a file anchor (`{ repo, path }`) opens the whole file, a line or range anchor scrolls to it. A plain string, or an object without an anchor, is a grey label that opens nothing. The page embeds every anchored file whole: give a lock file, a generated file or a file that may hold secrets no anchor.

label.description: Short name on the chip (`cli`, `store/fs`); the file name (and line) by default.

rule.description: What keeps the layer apart, e.g. “only calls the layer below”.

ruleAnchor.description: Where the rule shows in code.

highlight.description: The layer the question is about.
